definition: Table or desk; a raised horizontal surface typically supported by legs.
composition_note: 桌 (originally derived from 卓 zhuó 'eminent/high' + 木 mù 'wood') + nominalizing suffix 子 (zi). Measure word: 张 (zhāng).

example.en: The book is on the table.
example.es: El libro está sobre la mesa.
example.fr: Le livre est sur la table.

category: Household Objects & Furniture / 家居用品
note: Common classifier: 一张桌子 (yì zhāng zhuōzi = one table).

definition: Chair; a piece of furniture designed for one person to sit on, with a backrest.
composition_note: 椅 (phonetic 奇 qí + semantic 木 mù 'wood') + nominalizing suffix 子 (zi). Measure word: 把 (bǎ).

example.pinyin: Qǐng zuò zài zhè bǎ yǐzi shang.
example.ipa: [tɕʰìŋ tswɔ̂ tsâi̯ tʂɤ̂ pà ì.dz̥ɨ ʂaŋ]
example.es: Por favor siéntate en esta silla.
example.fr: Veuillez vous asseoir sur cette chaise.

category: Household Objects & Furniture / 家居用品
note: Classifier for chairs: 一把椅子 (yì bǎ yǐzi = one chair).

definition: Plate, dish, or tray used for holding food or serving meals.
composition_note: 盘 (semantic radical 皿 mǐn 'dish/container' + phonetic 舟/般) + nominalizing suffix 子 (zi). Measure word: 个 (gè) or 盘 (pán).

example.en: There are apples on the plate.
example.fr: Il y a des pommes dans l'assiette.

note: Can also be used as a measure word for a dish of food: 一盘菜 (yì pán cài = a plate of food).

definition: Pants, trousers, or slacks; outer garment covering the body from waist to ankles.
composition_note: 裤 (semantic radical 衤 yī 'clothing' + phonetic 库 kù 'storehouse') + nominalizing suffix 子 (zi). Measure word: 条 (tiáo).
note: Always uses the long-and-flexible measure word 条 (tiáo): 一条裤子 (yì tiáo kùzi).
